h: Korach Mistook the Future Equality for Present Perfection

p: In Midrash Rabbah on this parsha
A tallis that is entirely techeiles, etc.;
Now this needs to be understood:
from where did the Midrash Rabbah take it
In the Torah it is stated explicitly (Bamidbar 16:3):
and why do you exalt yourselves, etc."
And if it is because of the juxtaposition
between the matter of a tallis entirely of techeiles
and a house full of sefarim
and the matter of Korach's claim,
as is explicit in the pasuk?
according to what the Arizal wrote:
and there are those called the aspect of "uprightness."
And in the world that was destroyed
before the creation of the world,
it was then in the aspect of circles;
and in the world of rectification
the level of the aspect of uprightness began;
the aspect of circles will also be revealed.
of what they said at the end of Taanis
will make a circle-dance for the tzaddikim";
and there in Taanis it speaks of
the tzaddikim encircling in a dance
the yoke of His Kingship, blessed be His Name,
Hakadosh Baruch Hu with a crown.
and a crown is encompassing light.
"Keser Elyon is the Crown of Kingship,"
And this is the matter of
And in the aspect of circles
there are no levels at all,
which has no beginning and end.

p: at the time of Mattan Torah
as there will be in the future.
And this is what he claimed (Bamidbar 16:3):
"For the entire congregation, all of them are holy,"
and all of them heard at Sinai,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה, בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה יח, ו)
(as they said in Midrash Rabbah, Bamidbar Rabbah 18:6),
that is, as it will be in the future,
and they are around Him in a circle-dance,
there are no levels at all,
at the time of Mattan Torah,
that took place at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
as is written in the holy Zohar
And it is stated in the Mechilta
then there are no levels at all.
And so it was at Mattan Torah
and this revelation will not be
for that is the true rectification.
כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ לְיוֹסֵף וְגוֹמֵר (בְּרֵאשִׁית נ, יז)
'So shall you say to Yosef, etc.' (Bereishis 50:17)."
that were it not for the sake of peace,
the Torah would not have written
"The entire congregation, all of them are holy,"
for on the day of Shabbos,
then Hashem is in their midst;
is a semblance of the World to Come,
and there is in it a little revelation
of the matter of the level
that Hashem will be in their midst,
a semblance of the World to Come,
and it is also only on Shabbos.
And in truth, in the generation of the wilderness,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג כט, ב)
of the level of "and Hashem is in their midst."
as it will be in the future,
and that it is already so now.
will not be until the future,
it is only a semblance of it,
a semblance of the World to Come,
his words were written in the Torah.
